story_overview: Owen appears deeply distressed, first in a tuxedo while watched by Clara and Nadia, and later comforted by Leo outside a suburban house. As a mysterious silhouette of Alex watches from a window, a separate photoshoot takes place in a stark white studio involving Clara and Leo.

video_prompts:
Clara: Woman.
Nadia: Woman with her hair pulled back.
Owen: Man with a broad-shouldered build, short dark hair, wearing a black suit jacket with matching trousers and a black tie.
The Blue Room: An indoor space with a predominantly blue color palette.
the black suit: A black suit jacket with matching trousers and a black tie.
the dslr camera: Black Canon DSLR camera.

In The Blue Room, a distressed Owen wearing the black suit with his tie loosened walks forward, clutching his throat and looking around anxiously. Clara and Nadia watch from the background with concerned expressions, shifting slightly. The dslr camera sits on a nearby surface.
action_descriptions: In The Blue Room, a distressed Owen wearing the black suit with his tie loosened walks forward, clutching his throat and looking around anxiously. Clara and Nadia watch from the background with concerned expressions, shifting slightly. The dslr camera sits on a nearby surface.

video_prompts:
The Amber Lounge: Indoor bar setting defined by a yellow-hued color palette and the presence of bar glassware.
the ringing mobile phone: Mobile phone with a glowing screen displaying a notification for '4 Missed Calls: Liz'.
the glass of whiskey: A standard clear glass tumbler containing a translucent yellow liquid.

Close-up on Owen's hand holding the ringing mobile phone as it vibrates slightly in The Amber Lounge. In the softly blurred background, Clara sits at the bar, and the glass of whiskey rests on the countertop.
action_descriptions: Close-up on Owen's hand holding the ringing mobile phone as it vibrates slightly in The Amber Lounge. In the softly blurred background, Clara sits at the bar, and the glass of whiskey rests on the countertop.

video_prompts:
The Bokeh Field: Soft, overlapping circular glows of multicolored light against a dark expanse.
the glowing orbs: A scattering of soft, diffused, circular lights in shades of white and warm yellow against a dark backdrop.

Close-up on Owen in The Bokeh Field. He looks down with a concerned expression, his face partially obscured by shadow. Nadia, standing beside him, turns to look at him, as the glowing orbs float around them.
action_descriptions: Close-up on Owen in The Bokeh Field. He looks down with a concerned expression, his face partially obscured by shadow. Nadia, standing beside him, turns to look at him, as the glowing orbs float around them.

video_prompts:
the classic tuxedo: A classic black tuxedo jacket with satin lapels, matching black trousers, a crisp white formal shirt
the untied bowtie: An untied black satin self-tie bowtie, hanging as a long strip of fabric with flared ends.

In The Blue Room, Nadia, wearing the classic tuxedo, adjusts the untied bowtie at her collar. Clara enters the room and walks towards her, watching.
In The Blue Room, Nadia turns and walks away from Owen. Owen, wearing a plaid button-down shirt and jeans, stands alone and watches her leave with a concerned expression.

video_prompts:
Leo: Man with blond hair.
The Suburban House: Exterior of a house with a gravel driveway.
the striped leather jacket: Black jacket with white stripes, worn over a grey hoodie.

At The Suburban House at night, Leo, wearing the striped leather jacket, tightens his arm around Owen, who is wearing a dark blue and green plaid button-down shirt. Leo looks down at the distressed Owen with a concerned expression. Owen keeps his arms crossed, looking down at the ground.

Alex: Indistinct human form with no discernible features.

Wide, low-angle shot of The Suburban House at night. The building is illuminated by the warm glow of the warm light fixtures, set against a dark backdrop of the dense forest trees. In an upstairs window, the silhouetted form of Alex slowly turns their head.

the overgrown bush: Large, dense bush with dark green leaves and an unkempt, rounded shape.

Medium shot at night at The Suburban House. Leo stands with his arm around Nadia's shoulders next to the overgrown bush. They both look off-camera with concerned expressions, and then Nadia turns her head to speak to Leo.

video_prompts:
The White Studio: Indoor photo studio with a seamless white infinity cyclorama wall and matching floor, creating a bare, minimalist space.
the smokey eye makeup: Heavy, dark smokey eye makeup, featuring opaque black and charcoal eyeshadow blended from the lash line up past the crease, paired with thick, dark eyeliner on the upper and lower lash lines.

Close-up on the pensive face of Clara inside The White Studio. She is wearing the smokey eye makeup. She slowly turns her head to look slightly to the side.
Medium close-up of Leo inside The White Studio against a plain background. Leo holds the dslr camera with both hands, raising it to his eye to look through the viewfinder with concentration.
